Verified: gamedataService.lookup('1389-gamedata.base') -> { name: 'Shopkeeper goods bag', type: 46 }, and no other catalog entry claims that stringID. Too far apart for the conservative normaliser (which only folds case, apostrophes and punctuation) to join on its own.
